nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor; used as privileged access gate (msg.sender == owner) in delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress; also used as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address => uint256) counting how many sale/batch operations an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private uint256 limit of sale operations per address, set in init and read in condition.
Private uint256 minimum transfer amount, set in init and read in condition.
Private uint256 maximum transfer amount, set in init and read in condition.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist bypass consulted in ensure.
Address set by privileged setTradeAddress; acts as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a hardcoded whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public total supply, set once in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate: returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/whitelisted senders, otherwise enforces condition(_from,_value).
Public payable transferFrom: updates allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Internal view sale-limit checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only public payable function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address supplied by the caller.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from caller supplied values.
Owner-only payable batch airdrop; computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address computation using create2 hashing.
Payable constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, assigns owner = msg.sender and grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership assignment, privilege checks, transfers, approvals and the ensure whitelist.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address inside delegate, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend can silently overflow and corrupt the balance accounting.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Sender address argument of transferFrom.
Recipient address argument of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transferFrom.
Spender address argument of approve.
Target contract address of the delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate.
Sale count limit assigned to _saleNum in init.
Minimum sale amount basis assigned to _minSale in init.
Maximum sale amount basis assigned to _maxSale in init.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication.
Loop index over the recipient array in batchSend.
New trade address written to tradeAddress.
Uniswap factory address used in the create2 pair computation.
First token address in the pair computation.
Second token address in the pair computation.
Address whose _onSaleNum counter is compared against _saleNum in condition.
Amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Sender address checked against the whitelist in ensure.
Amount forwarded to condition from ensure.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, storing an untrusted caller as the privileged owner.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from address into transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom._from drives the allowance, balance and _onSaleNum updates.
transferFrom._to receives the credited balance.
transferFrom._value determines the debited/credited amount.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before mutating state.
ensure._from is compared against owner, UNI, the computed pair and tradeAddress.
ensure._value is passed to condition.
The hardcoded UNI router address is a whitelist bypass in ensure.
tradeAddress is a whitelist bypass in ensure.
canSale[_from] is a whitelist bypass in ensure.
owner and _from/_to comparisons in ensure create privileged transfer paths that skip all sale limits.
ensure enforces condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
condition._from indexes _onSaleNum.
condition._value is compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
_saleNum bounds how many transfers an address may make.
_minSale lower-bounds the transferred value.
_maxSale upper-bounds the transferred value.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance subtraction without SafeMath, allowing silent underflow.
The caller-supplied _value flows directly into the unchecked subtractions.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner.
approve._spender receives the granted allowance.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry.
delegate is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary caller-supplied address in this contract's storage context.
delegate.a is the arbitrary target of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
init is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
init.saleNum is written into _saleNum.
init.token scales and is written into _minSale.
init.maxToken scales and is written into _maxSale.
init sets _minSale, changing which transfers condition allows.
init sets _maxSale, changing which transfers condition allows.
init sets _saleNum, the per-address transfer quota.
batchSend is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend._tos provides the recipient array and its length.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing an overflow that bypasses the balance require.
The potentially overflowing local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
The loop index i drives the unbounded recipient iteration in batchSend.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the caller and every recipient.
setTradeAddress is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress.addr is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist bypass used by ensure.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist check.
pairFor.factory is used in the create2 address computation.
pairFor.tokenA is ordered and hashed in the pair computation.
pairFor.tokenB is ordered and hashed in the pair computation.

normalization_plan.reason: transferFrom._from is only the input address consumed by the transferFrom balance/allowance logic.
transferFrom._to is only the credited address consumed by transferFrom.
transferFrom._value is only the amount consumed by transferFrom and its unchecked arithmetic.
approve._spender is only the spender consumed by approve.
delegate.a is only the delegatecall target consumed by delegate.
delegate.b is only the delegatecall calldata consumed by delegate.
init.saleNum is only the value assigned to _saleNum inside init.
init.token is only the value assigned to _minSale inside init.
init.maxToken is only the value assigned to _maxSale inside init.
batchSend._tos is only the recipient array consumed by batchSend.
Local total exists only inside batchSend and feeds its unchecked multiplication.
Local loop index i exists only inside the batchSend iteration.
setTradeAddress.addr is only the value written to tradeAddress.
pairFor.factory is only an input to pairFor's create2 computation.
pairFor.tokenA is only an input to pairFor's create2 computation.
pairFor.tokenB is only an input to pairFor's create2 computation.
condition._from is only the lookup key into _onSaleNum inside condition.
condition._value is only compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
ensure._from is only the address tested against the whitelist in ensure.
ensure._value is only forwarded to condition from ensure.
